# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Manual composition root, no DI framework

- No Hilt/Koin/Dagger dependency anywhere in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`.
- Every ViewModel needing constructor dependencies gets a plain `ViewModelProvider.Factory` class in `app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/ui/ViewModelFactories.kt` (`NewSessionViewModelFactory`, `SettingsViewModelFactory`, `TrackingViewModelFactory`, `HistoryViewModelFactory`, `SessionDetailViewModelFactory`).
- Real dependencies (`AppDatabase`, `LocationPermissionManager`, `LocationForegroundServiceController`, `SessionControllerImpl`, `ExportService`, `SettingsRepository`) are constructed exactly once in `app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/MainActivity.kt` and threaded down through `ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt`'s per-route wrapper composables (`TrackingRoute`, `SettingsRoute`, `NewSessionRoute`).
- Not enforced by tooling (no lint rule blocks a DI framework) — it is a consistent hand-verified convention across `MainActivity.kt`, `AppNavigation.kt`, and `ViewModelFactories.kt`.

### 2. Reactive settings via `Flow.combine`

- ViewModels that need live settings combine their own data `Flow` with `settingsRepository.userSettings` via `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine`, so UI state updates immediately when a user changes a setting mid-screen, not just on next load.
- Verified in `app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/ui/tracking/TrackingViewModel.kt:86` and `app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/ui/history/HistoryViewModel.kt:107` — both `combine()` their DAO `Flow` with `settingsRepository.userSettings`.
- No static analysis enforces this; it is a structural pattern to follow for any new settings-aware ViewModel (`SettingsViewModel`, `SessionDetailViewModel` follow the same shape).

### 3. Hand-written fakes instead of mocking frameworks

- No Mockito/MockK dependency in `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (`testImplementation`/`androidTestImplementation` blocks in `app/build.gradle.kts` list only JUnit4, Robolectric, androidx.test, `kotlinx-coroutines-test`, `room-testing`, compose `ui-test`).
- Tests define plain in-memory implementations of DAO/controller interfaces inline: `FakeTrackingSessionDao`, `FakeGpsPointDao`, `FakeLocationServiceController` in `app/src/test/java/com/mytracksapp/domain/session/SessionControllerTest.kt`; further fakes exist in `app/src/test/java/com/mytracksapp/service/LocationCollectorTest.kt` and `app/src/test/java/com/mytracksapp/domain/geocoding/FirstPointGeocodingCoordinatorTest.kt`.
- New tests against a DAO/interface should add a fake in the test file rather than pull in a mocking library.

### 4. Per-screen `TestTags` object

- Every screen composable exposes a `<ScreenName>TestTags` object of stable `String` constants for Compose UI test targeting.
- Verified across `ui/tracking/TrackingScreen.kt`, `ui/tracking/MapComponent.kt`, `ui/history/HistoryListScreen.kt`, `ui/history/SessionDetailScreen.kt`, `ui/newsession/NewSessionScreen.kt`, `ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`, `ui/export/ExportFormatDialog.kt`, and `ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt` (`AppNavigationTestTags`).
- New screens/composables are expected to add their own `TestTags` object rather than target UI by string literal or content description.

### 5. Optional no-op test-seam lambdas

- Screen/composable functions expose extra trailing lambda parameters defaulting to no-op (e.g. `TrackingScreen`'s `onPolylineApplied`, `onKeepScreenOnApplied`; `MapComponent`'s `onPolylineApplied`/`onMarkersApplied`) so instrumented tests can observe internal state transitions without depending on Compose-internal test APIs or real Play Services map timing.
- Production call sites (`AppNavigation.kt`'s route composables) never set these parameters — they exist purely for the instrumented test suite (`app/src/androidTest/java/com/mytracksapp/ui/tracking/TrackingScreenTest.kt`).
